items.title: OpenCode Browse lets agents drive your real Chromium browser with logins
items.summary: OpenCode shipped Browse, an MCP server plus Chromium extension so coding agents can use your real browser tabs, logins and extensions instead of a clean headless session. Sensitive steps such as login, 2FA and payment hand the tab back to you; it works with OpenCode and other MCP clients including Claude Code and Codex.

doubt.pushback: Repliers warn that sharing a logged-in profile expands blast radius versus headless Browser MCP or Playwright, and ask how it differs from chrome MCP.

reception.summary: Builders welcome native real-browser control after workarounds; several insist on a dedicated profile and ask whether agents must confirm before acting in logged-in tabs.

items.title: Claude Code Projects cover much of the Conductor multi-repo workflow
items.summary: Anthropic's Lydia Hallie says Claude Code Projects can pick up pushed branches after you add a repo, covering much of the Conductor workflow for Pro, Max and Ultra users. Multiplayer is still missing; access is via waitlist for those tiers.

doubt.pushback: Feature is waitlisted for Pro/Max/Ultra and explicitly lacks Conductor's multiplayer; demo clip only, no docs link in the post.

reception.summary: Replies cheer the update and ask about Duet access; little first-hand try-it signal yet beyond enthusiasm.

items.title: Controlled Voice Arena: TTS ranks flip between US and UK English accents
items.summary: Artificial Analysis reports that with only the accent changed, Qwen-Audio-3.1-TTS-Plus leads in US English while HeyGen Voice leads in UK English and on the overall Controlled Voice Arena board. Twelve of 49 models show statistically significant US/UK gaps.

items.title: EXL3 quants of Ricursive Ripple-65B hit 99.3% top-1 vs BF16 at 45 GB
items.summary: Cruz released Sage-REX L3 EXL3 packs of Ricursive Intelligence's Ripple-65B dense model: a 5.41 bpw 45.2 GB pack with 99.34% top-1 agreement versus BF16 and up to 64.8 tok/s on an RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, plus a 22.3 GB pack at 96.49% agreement. Gives local runners two memory budgets for the same 65B checkpoint.

doubt.pushback: Low engagement so far; hype-styled release post, measurements are author-run.

items.title: OpenAI Agents SDK alpha.6 adds ScriptedResponses for offline tool tests
items.summary: OpenAI Agents Python SDK v0.24.0-alpha.6 adds ScriptedResponses so builders can exercise SDK sessions and Python tools with a fixed tool-call to result to final-answer path without a live model or API key. Keeps harness tests separate from live-model evals.

doubt.pushback: Surfaced via a low-reach discovery post; primary link is the GitHub release tag.
